datasets.name: HaluBench
datasets.construction: Crowdsourced and model-generated hallucinated responses to real questions
datasets.caveat: All examples are hallucinated (positive-only). Accuracy and specificity undefined in isolation. Use combined evaluation only.

datasets.name: RAGTruth
datasets.construction: RAG-based generation with human-labeled hallucination annotations
datasets.caveat: Imbalanced: 32.7% positive. Accuracy alone is misleading; use Balanced Accuracy and MCC.

datasets.name: HaluEval
datasets.construction: Automatically sampled hallucinated and factual responses evaluated by GPT-4
datasets.caveat: Balanced (50/50). Best single dataset for clean accuracy reporting.

datasets.name: Phase 6 Unseen Benchmark
datasets.construction: 105 novel unseen temporal verification cases across 15 domains and 15 temporal categories
datasets.caveat: Full pipeline evaluation yields Acc=53.33% (FP=46 from misleading evidence). Temporal-engine-only evaluation yields 89.52% — these are DIFFERENT configurations.

datasets.name: Phase 5 Holdout
datasets.source: Constructed for Phase 5 blind holdout (HalluciSense internal)
datasets.construction: 70 cases blind holdout; used as evaluation set in Phase 6 development
datasets.caveat: USED DURING PHASE 6 DEVELOPMENT. NOT suitable as a final test set for Phase 6C. Phase 6 achieved 88.57% on this set.

combined_external_550.note: Approximately balanced by coincidence from dataset mixing. Per-dataset distributions vary significantly.

final_test_set_principle.statement: The Phase 5 holdout (N=70) was used during Phase 6 architecture development and MUST NOT serve as a final test set. All Phase 6C final evaluation uses the 550-case external benchmark (HaluBench + RAGTruth + HaluEval) and the 105-case Phase 6 unseen benchmark.
